resources.string: Enter the address you open Meat Mode at in a browser. The app shows that hub\'s pages and lets it send reminders to this phone, so enter only a hub you run or trust.
Check that this phone is online and on the hub\'s network, then try again.
The hub\'s certificate is not trusted on this phone, so the app did not open it.
Turn reminders on or off in the hub\'s own Settings.
Waiting for the hub to confirm
Blocked: notifications are off in Android settings
Unavailable: no push service on this phone
Optimised: reminders through a push service app may arrive late
Your push service app wakes Meat Mode when a reminder comes in. Android delays that unless Meat Mode may run unrestricted. Give your push service app the same setting in its own settings.
Reminders on this phone stop, and the app signs out of the current hub.
Several apps on this phone can deliver pushes. Android will ask which one delivers Meat Mode\'s reminders; pick the one you use, such as ntfy or Sunup.
Notifications are off for Meat Mode. Allow them in Android settings.
No push service on this phone. Install a UnifiedPush distributor such as ntfy or Sunup, or use a phone with Google Play Services.
